targets.outcome_quote: Has Theory-of-Mind spontaneously emerged in large language models? Probably not. While LLMs such as GPT-3.5 now regurgitate reasonable responses to basic ToM vignettes, simple perturbations that keep the principle of ToM intact flip the answers on their head.
targets.outcome_reasoning: New model responses on altered task stimuli re-test the specific previous claim; this is new evaluation data, rather than a reanalysis of the prior response dataset. Overall assessment rejects spontaneous ToM and robust task success.
